lines.2: Kinu was sleeping like a rock again today, so I left her behind.
lines.4: Sato was walking along at an easy pace.
lines.5: Let's see. That book I read yesterday said...
lines.6: If you tell a girl, 'You're cute today too,' and she blushes, she might be into you.
lines.7: All right. With Sato, I could pass it off as a joke.
lines.8: Someday I'd try it on the Princess for real.
lines.10: When I called out to her...
lines.11: Sato's face lit up in an instant.
lines.15: Even my own voice came out a little high.
lines.16: Guess I shouldn't say things I'm not used to saying.
lines.19: 「Oh, come on. Calling me cute, Tsushima...」
lines.21: 「Don't tease me first thing in the morning.」
lines.22: She gave my arm a couple of light pats.
lines.25: If anything, she'd moved a little closer too.
lines.27: If I get conceited here, it'll only hurt me later.
lines.29: Just then, I felt a chill of murderous intent from behind me.
lines.31: I snapped my body to the left.
lines.32: 「Tch. You dodged. Your reaction speed is improving.」
lines.33: The Princess had stopped her bicycle exactly where I'd been standing a moment ago.
lines.34: 「Would you stop trying to run people over?」
lines.35: 「You were getting all cozy with Yoppi, so I got jealous.」
lines.38: 「It's a joke. You don't have to reject me that coldly.」
lines.39: 「Ahaha. Look at you getting hurt like a big boy.」
